name: smwmusic-touhou-kaikidan-mystic-square-harmony-of-gensokyo-romantic-children-remix
title: Touhou Kaikidan ~ Mystic Square - Harmony of Gensokyo ~ Romantic Children (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Romantic Children from Touhou 5: Mystic Square for Summer C3 2021. Wouldn't be a proper C3 if I didn't have at least one Touhou arrangement, so I thought I'd do another one from one of my favorite Touhou games for sure.

Romantic Children absolutely slaps, and that's all I need to say.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch)
